newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Bombay bullion market was closed on Thursday for a national holiday. Trading resumes on Friday.
On Wednesday, standard gold 24 carats was steady at 4,750 rupees per 10 grammes. It lost 20 rupees per 10 grammes on Tuesday on weak world prices, a trend unchanged on Wednesday.
Gold biscuits (116.50 grammes) also closed steady at 55,500 rupees per piece.

Silver.999 recovered to close five rupees higher at 6,735 rupees per kg on improved buying. It opened 15 rupees lower at 6,715 rupees per kg on higher arrivals and a weak world trend. (Conversion $1=35.77 rupees)
